mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, pr.response_text AS partner_response_text, pu.full_name AS partner_responder_name, pr.updated_at AS partner_responded_at FROM user_reviews r LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rr.response_text, rr.responder_user_id, rr.updated_at FROM marketplace_review_responses rr WHERE rr.review_id = r.id AND rr.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY rr.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) pr ON TRUE LEFT JOIN users pu ON pu.id = pr.responder_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reviews ( id, user_id, place_id, activity_booking_id, trip_id, hotel_booking_id, activity_order_id, checkin_lat, checkin_lng, checkin_accuracy_m, location_verified, overall_rating, food_rating, price_rating, ambiance_rating, service_rating, location_rating, cleanliness_rating, facilities_rating, text, photos, weight, helpful_votes, unhelpful_votes ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{placeId}, #{activityBookingId}, #{tripId}, #{hotelBookingId}, #{activityOrderId}, #{checkinLat}, #{checkinLng}, #{checkinAccuracy}, #{locationVerified}, #{overallRating}, #{foodRating}, #{priceRating}, #{ambianceRating}, #{serviceRating}, #{locationRating}, #{cleanlinessRating}, #{facilitiesRating}, #{text}, NULL, #{weight}, #{helpfulVotes}, #{unhelpfulVotes} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reviews SET overall_rating = #{overallRating}, food_rating = #{foodRating}, price_rating = #{priceRating}, ambiance_rating = #{ambianceRating}, service_rating = #{serviceRating}, location_rating = #{locationRating}, cleanliness_rating = #{cleanlinessRating}, facilities_rating = #{facilitiesRating}, checkin_lat = #{checkinLat}, checkin_lng = #{checkinLng}, checkin_accuracy_m = #{checkinAccuracy}, location_verified = #{locationVerified}, text = #{text}, photos = NULL, helpful_votes = #{helpfulVotes}, unhelpful_votes = #{unhelpfulVotes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_reviews SET helpful_votes = #{helpfulVotes}, unhelpful_votes = #{unhelpfulVotes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
WHERE (#{excludeUserId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} IS NULL OR r.user_id != #{excludeUserId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'REVIEW' AND t.content_id = r.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL) AND ( NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.text, '')), '') IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.entity_type = 'USER_REVIEW' AND ma.entity_id = r.id AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY
MD5(r.id::text || #{randomSeed})
( (r.overall_rating * 8) + (LEAST(r.helpful_votes, 20) * 2) + CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.text, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.entity_type = 'USER_REVIEW' AND ma.entity_id = r.id AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL ) THEN 8 ELSE 0 END + GREATEST(0, 30 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - r.created_at)) / 86400) + MOD(ABS(('x' || SUBSTR(MD5(r.id::text || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH12')), 1, 8))::bit(32)::bigint), 10) ) DESC, r.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_reviews WHERE activity_booking_id = #{activityBookingId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(helpful_votes), 0) FROM user_reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId}
